description: Prefect connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's data-orchestration deployments from a Prefect Cloud workspace or a self-hosted Prefect Server as prefect:deployment items in the local index — the deployment id, name, flow id, description, tags, paused flag, work pool, work queue, schedule, status, and created/updated timestamps. Useful for answering orchestration questions ("which deployments are paused?", "what's the schedule for the nightly flow?") without leaving Nimbus. Bearer-token auth (Prefect API key; required for Cloud, may be empty for self-hosted Server but still injected for uniform wiring). Prefect has no universal SaaS host: the per-tenant workspace API root is supplied via the prefect api_url vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by phase3AddPrefectMcp, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. The list endpoint is a POST filter: POST <api_url>/deployments/filter with a JSON body { limit, offset, sort } returns a bare JSON array of deployments; the connector walks a single forward offset pass per cycle, capped. v1 indexes deployments only — individual flow runs and task runs are a deferred follow-up. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
